newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures end erratic session firmer, off highs.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures end erratic session firmer, off highs.

text.p: FCOJ futures opened slightly lower, climbed over unchanged and soared sharply up before ending the day firmer but off the session peak.
Speculative buying stymied early losses and pushed the market into buy stops, which rallied July to a high of 84.70 cents.
Trade selling on the close knocked prices off the highs, but the market managed to rack up gains on the day.

The spot-July contract ended 0.35 cent higher at 82.70 cents per lb, having ranged from 84.70 to 80.80 cents. Second-position September finished 0.15 firmer at 84.65 cents, while the rest of the board settled up 0.45 to 0.85 cent. Barring fundamental news, the market is likely to trade sideways to lower, particularly during the summer months when demand from juice drops off, analysts said.
Technical support was seen at 79.80 cents basis July.
Volume was estimated at 3,600 lots compared with Wednesday's official 1,730 lots.
Players await the weekly movement number released this afternoon.
